== Remastered image publication bound ==
The current remastered image is present byte-for-byte in the Players Committee Holotable update dated 3 October 2025.<ref>Players Committee Holotable: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/c150ab8b996e747f2665f36d4ed3f3fc7a955c6e image update dated 3 October 2025], [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/c150ab8b996e747f2665f36d4ed3f3fc7a955c6e/Images-HT/starwars/Dagobah-Light/large/itisthefutureyousee.gif complete remastered face].</ref> The Released and Remastered rows therefore use “by 3 October 2025” for this image state. This bound does not identify its first release or date the original physical printing. The older 2018 file at the same path is a different physical scan; its date is not applied to this remaster. The infobox Title uses the printed card title; “Remastered” remains the wiki article qualifier.
